items.title: 8.3 Plane polarized light paida karna aur pakarna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.3 with Fig. 8.5 (PDF 176-177).

blocks.text: Aam incandescent bulb (aur Suraj) ki light unpolarized hoti hai, kyun ke us ki (electric) vibrations space mein be-tarteeb (randomly) har simt mein hoti hain (Fig. 8.5 (a) ka shuru wala hissa).

Agar unpolarized light polaroid ki sheet (polarizer) par dali jaye to guzarne wali light plane polarized hoti hai. Ab doosri polaroid sheet is tarah rakhein ke dono ke axes (un par bani seedhi lakeerein) parallel hon (Fig. 8.5 (a)); light doosri polaroid se bhi guzar jati hai. Agar doosri polaroid (analyzer) ko beam ke gird aahista ghumayein, to nikalne wali light madhham hoti jati hai aur jab dono axes ek doosre ke perpendicular ho jayein to bilkul ghayab ho jati hai (Fig. 8.5 (b)). Mazeed ghumane par light wapas aati hai aur jab axes dobara parallel hon to sab se roshan hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab parallel polaroids ke liye “(Fig. 8.5-b)” likhti hai. Figure 8.5 mein parallel axes wala hissa (a) hai, jahan light guzarti hai; (b) mein axes perpendicular (crossed) hain aur light nahi guzarti.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Har simt mein larazti unpolarized roshni polarizer se guzar kar aik plane mein larazti nikalti hai. (a) Analyzer ka axis polarizer ke mutawazi ho to roshni guzarti hai aur screen roshan hai. (b) Analyzer 90 degree ghuma dein to roshni nahi guzarti aur screen andheri, jo dikhata hai ke roshni ki lehrein transverse hain.
blocks.caption: Mutawazi (a) aur aar-paar (b) axes wale polarizer aur analyzer: roshni ki lehrein transverse hain (Figure 8.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yeh tajurba sabit karta hai ke light waves transverse hain. Agar light longitudinal hoti to dono polaroids perpendicular hone par bhi kabhi ghayab na hoti.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Polaroid ko ek jaali (grill) samjhein jis ki salakhein ek hi simt mein hain. Rassi ki transverse wave sirf us jaali se guzarti hai jis ki salakhein vibration ke parallel hon; doosri jaali 90° par ho to wave ruk jati hai. Longitudinal wave (aage-peeche vibration) har jaali se guzar jati, is liye kabhi na rukti.

blocks.caption: Analyzer ko ghumana
rows: wapas aati hai, sab se roshan

blocks.title: Ponder Upon
blocks.text: Pani ki hamwar (smooth) satah se reflect hone wali light satah ke parallel partially (kuch had tak) polarized hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Daen oopar se dhoop hamwar jheel par parti hai aur baen kinare khare shakhs tak mun'akis hoti hai. Aati shua par khare aur pare dohre teer barabar; mun'akis shua par lamba para dohra teer aur sirf chhota khara teer.
blocks.caption: Ponder Upon (PDF page 177): Pani ki hamwar sath se mun'akis light sath ke mutawazi juzvi polarized hoti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dhoop mein vibrations har simt mein barabar hain (barabar teer). Pani se reflect hone ke baad satah ke parallel (horizontal) vibration zyada aur vertical kam reh jati hai: light partially polarized hai. Isi liye polarized sunglasses pani ki chamak kam kar dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Jab I₀ intensity ki unpolarized light polarizing sheet par pare to kitni intensity nahi guzarti (numerical 8.1)? Kya polarizer ko analyzer ke taur par istemal kiya ja sakta hai (constructed response 8.2)?
blocks.explanation: Polarizer vibrations ka sirf woh hissa guzarta hai jo us ke axis ke saath ho; unpolarized light ke liye yeh aadhi intensity hai. To I₀/2 guzarti hai aur I₀/2 nahi guzarti. Haan: polarizer aur analyzer ek jaisi polaroid sheets hain; naam sirf un ki jagah se badalta hai. Fig. 8.5 mein doosri polaroid analyzer hai, aur pani ya mez se reflect hone wali light ke samne ghumai gayi polaroid sheet ya polarized sunglasses bhi analyzer ka kaam karti hain.

items: Bulb ya Suraj ki light unpolarized hai. Polarizer plane polarized light banata hai. Analyzer (doosri polaroid): axes parallel par light guzarti hai, ghumane se madhham hoti hai, crossed (90°) par ghayab, phir parallel par sab se roshan.
Is se sabit hota hai ke light transverse hai: longitudinal wave crossed polaroids mein kabhi ghayab na hoti.
